PolaritonPhase5u, DispersionAndPolariton, KerrSchild.PolaritonCrossBridge and KerrSchild.SingleCopy have no source file or built module record at the pinned base. Direct full-source/history review plus source-matching imported inspection of the three built modules shows GrapheneHawking supplies generic arithmetic and a definitional temperature identity; SoftTheorems.NoiseFloorPrediction defines an occupation floor delta_k/2 and Wilson invariance, not the E1 mean-field energy temperature; WKBConnection uses an assumed modified-unitarity carrier and decoherence occupation not asserted by E1. This event reconciles historical direct registrations; it does not remove Lean source, change scientific scope or certify bundle freshness.
